name: shadowiron
protection_note: Iron from the void: the dark is at home in it.
protection_price: Holy light burns through it, it conducts lightning, and it can never be blessed.
lore_descriptor: matte black and seems to drink the light around it
first_pickup_chronicle: Put on shadowiron. It drinks from me a little all the time, like a tick with manners. In exchange, I am very hard to hurt.
design_notes: Curse-flavor magical_metal. Drains wearer 1 HP/turn. Strong AC tradeoff.
